t: This is Marsham Court, an apartment building on Marsham Street in Victoria. It was designed in the Art Deco style by Thomas Bennett of T.P. Bennett and Son in 1937. Two notable residents are linked to it. Sir Maurice Oldfield lived here from 1970 to 1981. He was a British intelligence officer who served as the seventh director of the Secret Intelligence Service, MI6, from 1973 to 1978. Sir Albert Braithwaite, a Conservative politician, both lived and died here.
